selection: Sequential disjoint strata, 20 each; within each stratum ascending SHA256 of UTF8 j4-audit-v1|source_sha256|decimal_transcription_id. French-language source dossier 1753 is reserved first in the multiple-school stratum, then the first 19 eligible ranked records. Other strata exclude all already selected IDs.

stratum_rules.multiple_schools: Source transkription_mehrere_schulen equals 1; no claim that every answer is owned by every linked school
stratum_rules.null_text: At least one source antwort field is SQL NULL
stratum_rules.long_or_free_text: At least one question ID is 57 or greater, or an original quoted SQL answer token exceeds 2000 bytes including quoting/escapes; not a decoded character length
stratum_rules.editorial_markup: At least one raw source answer token contains @ or $; a selection cue, not an assertion that all markup is understood
stratum_rules.short_single_school: Source multiple-school flag is not 1, no NULL text, no free-text question ID >=57, and maximum raw quoted answer-token length is below 1000 bytes; flag-based stratum, actual school links still need audit

audit_checks: Complete public dossier projection and associated answers
Exact original text and NULL/blank distinctions
Source archive locator and unverified PDF page kept null
Duplicate evidence and unresolved school assignment preserved
limitations: Purposefully stratified development audit, not a representative random estimate of corpus correctness
Physical manuscript transcription accuracy is outside this audit
100 selected IDs are not 100 passing documents
